description: Get upload URLs for receipt files (png, jpg, jpeg, pdf; up to 25 MB each, at most 10 per call) so you can send them to concur_upload_receipt from anywhere — this is how to upload to a hosted (remote) server, which cannot read files on your machine. Each slot has a `curl` command: run it with the file's real path in place of the placeholder (it must send exactly the Content-Type shown), then call concur_upload_receipt with the slot's `blobKey`. The URLs expire in 30 minutes. Changes nothing in Concur. Needs the blob store a hosted deployment provides.

files.description: The receipt files to upload, by name (and optionally MIME type).

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Default: inferred from the filename extension. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.

name: concur_upload_slots
